newsitem.title: UK: ICI says sale cuts gearing by 20 points.
newsitem.headline: ICI says sale cuts gearing by 20 points.

text.p: Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc sad on Monday that the $3 billion sale of industrial chemicals businesses to DuPont Co would cut its gearing by around 20 percentage points.
In a telephone conference call, finance director Alan Spall declined to give an exact figure for the group's gearing, but said it was "below 100 percent."

Spall said the disposal to DuPont, the sale of most of ICI's majority holding in ICI Australia Ltd and a 100 million stg sale and leaseback deal on its London headquarters, meant that around 60 percent of the 5 billion stg paid for Unilever Plc's speciality chemicals business had been recovered.
